summary: Temporary danger area for drone flights near Thetford, with a 1.6 nautical mile radius and drones limited to 400 feet above ground level.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD294E INSTALLED WI 1.6NM RADIUS OF
522501N 0004501E (THETFORD). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (BVLOS)
UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT AGL. EMERG SER 
ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL DECONFLICTION 
AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (VLOS) UAS 
OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL OR 
DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE
OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE
REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING
OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. 
FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2026-7514/03.
